scope: The standing Church of Our Lady of the Rosary of Black Men at the Largo do Rosário in Ouro Preto, including the bowed three-arch entrance, cylindrical bell towers, elliptical nave and chancel, and rear attached fabric.
era: Standing church in the historic Rosário district of Ouro Preto.
